learning_unit.purpose: Identify the firing weapon to anticipate marks, healing, control, splash or strengthened follow-up attacks; spread against Infernum and respect Crescendum afterward.
learning_unit.title: Moonlight Vigil: weapon-dependent ultimate

row.answer: Moonlight Vigil explodes on an enemy champion, deals physical damage to champions in the area, then follows with physical attacks carrying the main-hand weapon's effect chosen when fired; swapping during flight does not change it. Calibrum applies empowered marks; Severum heals Aphelios through the blast and follow-up attacks; Gravitum applies an enhanced slow and lets Binding Eclipse root affected targets for longer. Infernum increases the initial blast's damage and makes follow-up attacks splash around targets, with overlapping areas damaging champions; Crescendum grants mirror chakrams, increasing with the number of targets hit by the initial blast.
row.counterplay: Assess his main-hand weapon when he fires; spread out against Infernum and respect Crescendum's strengthened attacks afterward.
